title: Voices of Equality
shared_visual_asset: Directly recreates the founder's original deck slide, which paired Susan B. Anthony and Martin Luther King, Jr. under one 'Voices of Equality' header.
merge_rationale: The first cluster in this project spanning two different official categories — fact 99 is '1800s', fact 113 is 'Recent American History'. Clusters were previously implicit within a single category or within an entity hub; this confirms structural clusters can cross category boundaries too, same as entity clusters already did.
